storage_policy.other_mounts_checked: Project ext4 currently has 58,386,644,992 bytes free; /tmp has 7,732,916,224 bytes free and is below the 43,162,945,556-byte full-matrix free-space model; the previously inspected external volume remains read-only and was not modified.
storage_policy.post_review_target: Keep necessary records, configs, audit receipts, and high-value results; after each case retain only verified compact plus compressed full-output receipt and keep final project allocated bytes below 20,000,000,000.
storage_policy.required_resource_gate: Before each case, require actual filesystem free bytes >= remaining retained compact-plus-gzip-receipt projection with 25% margin + measured full-case P0 temporary peak 29,821,104,128 bytes + 10 GiB reserve. Independently require actual project allocated bytes excluding the active raw case + the remaining retained-archive projection with 25% margin <= 20,000,000,000 bytes. The target-present +4 ns receipt component uses a conservative model from the actual P0 full-output manifest and is explicitly identified as modeled.
